scripts.copia: mkdir -p dist && cp -r assets .well-known en dist/ && cp *.html _headers _redirects robots.txt sitemap.xml site.webmanifest llms.txt favicon.ico dist/
scripts.html: html-minifier-terser --input-dir dist --output-dir dist --file-ext html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --remove-redundant-attributes --minify-css true --minify-js true
scripts.js: for f in dist/assets/js/*.js dist/assets/libs/cookieconsent/*.js; do terser "$f" --compress --mangle --output "$f"; done
scripts.build: npm run pulisci && npm run copia && npm run html && npm run js && npm run css && npm run img
